## Course

An introduction to analyzing repeated clinical measurements, using a fictional blood
pressure cohort.

## Rendering

Run `uv run quarto render` from the course folder. Pages go to `rendered/`: modules to
`rendered/modules/`, slides to `rendered/slides/`, and so on.
